blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `validateTranslationsStep`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.
This step validates that the translations are supported by the store.

children.name: reference_id
children.description: The ID of the data model being translated.

children.name: reference
children.description: The name of the table that the translation belongs to.

children.name: locale_code
children.description: The BCP 47 language tag code for this translation.

children.name: translations
children.description: The translated fields as key-value pairs.

children.name: id
children.description: The ID of the translation to update.
